title: The Countdown of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji stepped into the teleportation array, a sharp sword light slashed down from the Void, and Ye Qing's voice cut like ice: 'If you open the Kunlun Seal, neither of us will exist anymore—are you certain you wish to gamble everything?'

text.content: The moment the Tianji Record's true form merged into his Brow Center, Chen Ji felt the entire world change. Countless strands of karma wove into a web before his eyes, past, present, and future flowing like three intertwined rivers, and he himself stood at the crossroads of fate. The oppressive force emanating from the imperial city was like a tangible mountain—that was the gaze of the Heavenly Eye—cold, scrutinizing, like a deity looking down upon ants. His knuckles whitened as his grip tightened. The Heavenly Fate value continued its frantic drain. Every second was a countdown.

dialogue.content: The host of the Tianji Record, have you finally decided to reveal yourself?

text.content: A figure gradually materialized from the Void, robed in imperial garments yet devoid of any mortal monarch's aura. His eyes were like two swirling abysses, seeming to devour all light and hope. Chen Ji recognized that face—the imperial nation's Guardian Heavenly Master, titled 'Tianzhu', a figure rumored to have lived for three thousand years. Yet the aura emanating from him at this moment far surpassed any powerhouse Chen Ji had ever encountered—it was a fragment of the Heavenly Dao's laws themselves projected.

dialogue.content: Surrender the complete Tianji Record, and this one shall allow you to retain a thread of consciousness, becoming the Heavenly Dao's walker in the mortal realm. Otherwise—the sixty thousand imperial soldiers, three thousand Nascent Soul cultivators, and twelve Mahasattva experts will reduce the Tianqing Sect's surrounding thousand miles to ashes tonight.
(A light laugh, yet his eyes held no mirth) Tianzhu, your hand is indeed grand. Unfortunately, this Tianji Record... it itself seems rather unwilling to follow you.

text.content: A barely perceptible frown crossed Tianzhu's brow. In the next instant, the space around Chen Ji solidified abruptly, transforming into an invisible cage. The pressure of Heavenly Dao laws descended like ten million mountains simultaneously, and Chen Ji's bones emitted dangerous creaking sounds. Is this the power beyond Mahasattva? Indeed not something he could oppose head-on at present. Yet the smile at the corner of his lips deepened instead—because he had waited for this moment far too long.

Tianzhu raised his right hand, and a pitch-black token condensed in his palm. That was the imperial nation's nation-protecting divine artifact—the Heavenly Punishment Token. Once deployed, spiritual energy within ten thousand li would be drained dry, turning the area into a dead realm. However, just as he was about to activate it, a sword light like a reversed Milky Way hacked apart that solidified space by force!

dialogue.content: Tianzhu, your intimidation is impressive, but Qingyao stands here—you cannot touch him.

text.content: Su Qingyao, in pristine white attire, stood before Chen Ji with her sword pointing at the heavens. Her aura was worlds apart from three days prior—no longer merely at the Transformation God stage, but subtly touching the threshold of Mahasattva. When had she broken through? More critically... why was she appearing here? Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, alarm bells ringing in his heart. From his understanding of Su Qingyao, she would never appear without reason.

dialogue.content: (Turning around, looking at Chen Ji with complex eyes) Master was right—you were indeed waiting for me here. Chen Ji... no, what should I call you? The host of the Tianji Record? Or Chen Tianming's chess piece?
(Gazing at her calmly) Su Senior Sister's intelligence network is impressive. Though... that word 'chess piece' sounds rather unexpected coming from you.

text.content: Su Qingyao did not respond, but instead retrieved a Jade Slip from her sleeve. That Jade Slip radiated a familiar temporal-spatial fluctuation—it was Chen Tianming's aura! Chen Ji's heart raced suddenly. He should have anticipated this. Chen Tianming, with his ten-thousand-year stratagem, would inevitably have positioned a contingency within the Tianqing Sect. Yet never in his wildest dreams did he imagine that crucial piece would be Su Qingyao.

dialogue.content: This is the final divine thought my master transmitted through the time-space rift. He said... 'One last matter—open the Kunlun Seal.' (Extending the Jade Slip toward Chen Ji) The rest, you'll perceive yourself.

text.content: Chen Ji accepted the Jade Slip, his spiritual sense probing within. In an instant, Chen Tianming's aged and weary voice resonated through his consciousness: 'Child, when you hear these words, your master will likely have passed from this world. Beneath the Kunlun Seal lies an existence far more ancient than the Heavenly Eye... it is the true sovereign of this heavens and earth. The Heavenly Eye is merely its eye, while the Tianji Record in your hands is a shackle forged by its own hand. Go, open the seal, and restore everything to its origin.'

dialogue.content: (Tianzhu's expression changed drastically, his tone carrying rare urgency) What are you doing! The Kunlun Seal absolutely cannot—

(Interrupting him, with an even deeper smile) Cannot be opened? Tianzhu, your reaction actually piques my curiosity. What could possibly lie within the Kunlun Seal that would unsettle the Heavenly Eye's representative so profoundly?

text.content: Tianzhu offered no response, but his silence was answer enough. Chen Ji suddenly comprehended—the reason the Heavenly Eye sought to seize the Tianji Record was not because it feared this divine artifact, but because it feared the Tianji Record's host opening the Kunlun Seal! What lay within would perhaps be an existence even the Heavenly Eye could not control. And this... was Chen Tianming's true ultimate design.

dialogue.content: (Sheathing her sword, her voice cold and clear) Master instructed me to relay: 'This journey to Kunlun offers nine deaths and one life. But should you not go, everything you cherish will be reduced to ashes in the Heavenly Eye's reckoning.' Chen Ji, what is your choice?

choice.prompt: Facing Tianzhu's threats, the information brought by Su Qingyao, and Chen Tianming's final testament, Chen Ji must make his choice.

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Eye fears the Kunlun Seal so greatly, it shall be my sole breaking point. Regardless of whether the path ahead leads to nine deaths or utter destruction, I must walk this journey.
choices.visible_cost: Losing imperial protection, about to become an enemy of the entire world
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the complete method to unseal Kunlun and gain Su Qingyao's full support
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Way will stop at nothing to prevent you

text.content: (Turns to face Tianzhu, eyes calm as still water) I appreciate your kindness, Elder Tianzhu. But rather than being someone else's chess piece, I'd rather see... if this Heavenly Way can truly be overturned

Tianzhu's expression completely darkened. He said nothing more, only slowly raising the Punishment Decree in his hand. At that moment, the sky suddenly darkened—not from clouds blocking the sun, but from the Eye of Heavenly Way's gaze descending completely. From the direction of the imperial capital, countless pillars of light shot into the sky—a signal that all the empire's power was gathering

choices.description: Since Tianzhu dares to come alone, he must have something to rely on. Before heading to Kunlun, we must eliminate this greatest earthly agent of the Eye of Heavenly Way—even if it means revealing more hidden cards
choices.visible_cost: Revealing strength prematurely might attract more enemies
choices.visible_reward: Might deal a heavy blow to the Eye of Heavenly Way's earthly foundations
choices.risk_hint: Tianzhu's strength is unfathomable, and imperial reinforcements could arrive at any moment

text.content: (Suddenly surges forward, Tianji Record's power condensing at his fingertips) Su Senior Sister, may I borrow your sword intent!

A flicker of surprise crossed Su Qingyao's eyes, but in the next instant, her long sword had already left its sheath, sword intent pouring forth like the Milky Way, perfectly intertwining with Chen Ji's Heavenly Mechanism power. It was their first time fighting side by side, yet they moved as if they had rehearsed it a thousand times. Tianzhu's pupils contracted sharply—he hadn't expected that a female cultivator at the Transformation God stage and atrash who had just merged with the Tianji Record could unleash such terrifying power working together!

choices.description: Don't rush to decide. First extract more information. Tianzhu is so desperate for the Tianji Record, which means the Eye of Heavenly Way behind him has weaknesses too. An enemy's fear is my bargaining chip
choices.visible_cost: Might be seen as weakness, giving enemies an opening
choices.visible_reward: Gather more intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Way and the Kunlun seal
choices.risk_hint: Tianzhu might see through your stalling tactics

text.content: (Steps back, putting on a thoughtful appearance) Elder Tianzhu's words require time for me to digest. However... before making a decision, I'm quite curious about one thing

Tianzhu slightly narrowed his eyes, clearly surprised by Chen Ji's change in attitude, but he didn't mind giving this ant a few more seconds. After all, in his view, no matter how Chen Ji struggled, he couldn't escape the Eye of Heavenly Way's chessboard. 'What do you want to ask?'

Su Qingyao sheathed her sword and stepped to Chen Ji's side. Her gaze fell on the jade slip, a subtle tenderness flickering in her eyes. 'Master said the key to unsealing Kunlun lies within you.' She paused, 'Is he right?' Chen Ji didn't answer. Instead, he slowly raised his right hand. At his palm, an ancient divine pattern was slowly emerging—the core secret of the Tianji Record's seventh page, the secret Chen Tianming had guarded until death. So that's it. He finally understood his master's layout. From the beginning, the Tianji Record Fragment choosing him wasn't merely due to his talent. It was because... he was the sole key to unsealing Kunlun

Tianzhu's expression completely changed. He strode forward, Heavenly Way laws rumbling like thunder around him, 'You dare!' Chen Ji raised his head, meeting those fathomless eyes, a curve appearing at the corner of his lips. 'What wouldn't I dare?' His voice was soft, yet carried a resolve of one who had burned his bridges, 'Elder Tianzhu, you've served the Eye of Heavenly Way for so many years. You should know better than anyone—when a person is driven to desperation, they can do anything.' The words fell, and from the direction of the imperial capital came a thunderous roar. A nationwide manhunt had been issued

Chen Ji took a deep breath and turned to look at Su Qingyao. 'Let's go, to Kunlun.' 'Are you insane?' Su Qingyao frowned, 'The entire empire is now your enemy, you—' 'Precisely because of that, we must go.' Chen Ji interrupted her, a certain resolve flickering in his eyes, 'Chen Tianming was right. If I don't go, everything I care about will be wiped out. Better to... flip the entire chessboard.' His voice was calm, as if discussing a trivial matter. But Su Qingyao saw something in his eyes that made her heart tremble—that was the madness of one who had transcended life and death, and also the clarity that comes from seeing through everything. How many more trump cards is this man hiding?

Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, then suddenly laughed softly. 'Fine. Since you're not afraid, why should I, Su Qingyao, have any fear?' She raised her hand, and the light of a teleportation array glowed, 'The Kunlun entrance is on the eastern sea shore. From here, it takes about three hours. Chen Ji—' She looked at him, her expression complex, 'Are you truly prepared? Once we enter Kunlun, there's no road back.' Chen Ji didn't answer. He simply stepped into the teleportation array. His back view was calm, as if what awaited ahead wasn't a nine-death survival ordeal, but a fate long since destined. Su Qingyao followed behind, and an inexplicable emotion suddenly surged in her heart. If this journey truly was a farewell... then what meaning did all her years of perseverance hold?
